easy.def: To give an answer when you are not sure.
examples: Can you guess what is in the box?
I guess you are six years old.
Guess which hand has the coin.

more.def: To give an answer or opinion without knowing for certain.
examples: I guessed that there were two hundred beans in the jar.
Can you guess the ending of the story?
I did not know the answer, so I had to guess.

more.def: To lead or show the way to someone.
examples: A ranger guided us along the trail to the waterfall.
The stars guided sailors across the sea long ago.
A helper guided the new student to her classroom.
